# Ceylan Hukuk Bürosu / Ceylan Law Office

> Ceylan Hukuk Bürosu, 1987'den beri Antalya ve İstanbul'da hizmet veren profesyonel bir hukuk bürosudur.
> Ceylan Law Office has been providing professional legal services in Antalya and Istanbul since 1987.

## About

Ceylan Law Office is a full-service law firm based in Antalya and Istanbul, Turkey. Founded in 1987, the firm specializes in commercial law, real estate law, citizenship law, family law, corporate law, trademark and patent law, bankruptcy law, and maritime law. The firm provides legal services in Turkish, English, German, Russian, and Arabic.

## Services / Practice Areas

- Commercial and Corporate Law (Ticaret ve Şirketler Hukuku)
- Real Estate Law (Gayrimenkul Hukuku)
- Citizenship Law (Vatandaşlık Hukuku)
- Family and Inheritance Law (Aile ve Miras Hukuku)
- Trademark and Patent Law (Marka ve Patent Hukuku)
- Bankruptcy and Enforcement Law (İcra ve İflas Hukuku)
- Maritime Commercial Law (Deniz Ticareti Hukuku)
- Labor Law (İş Hukuku)
- Administrative Law (İdare Hukuku)
- Competition Law (Rekabet Hukuku)
- Malpractice Law (Malpraktis Hukuku)

## Team

- **Av. K. Kutluay Ceylan** - Founding Partner. Ankara University Faculty of Law 1986. 35+ years of legal experience. Official mediator and trademark representative.
- **Av. Fatma Ceylan** - Partner Attorney. Ankara University Faculty of Law 1986. Family law specialist and women's rights advocate.
- **Av. Oğuz Ceylan** - Partner Attorney. Robert Kolej 2016, Koç University 2020. Certified English court interpreter.
